title: Contents Packout & Storage — Service Tier Classification Card
content:
Every Contents Packout & Storage job is held at one of six tiers. The tier is fixed at booking from the scope described in that tier's entry gate, and the tier decides which price list, storage terms and billing terms apply to the job.

## Entry gates by tier

| Rank | Tier | Scope that places a job on the tier | Further entry condition | Storage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | On-Site Contents Manipulation | contents moved, blocked and protected inside the property | — | none |
| 2 | In-Plant Contents Cleaning | selected items taken to the cleaning plant and returned | — | none |
| 3 | Partial Contents Packout | contents of up to 3 rooms packed out | at most 3 rooms | yes |
| 4 | Full Contents Packout | contents of the whole dwelling packed out | at least 4 rooms | yes |
| 5 | High-Value Contents Packout | whole-dwelling packout with itemized high-value inventory | at least 10 high-value items | yes |
| 6 | Commercial Contents and Records Recovery | commercial inventory, equipment and records | the customer is a commercial owner, a property manager or a homeowners association | yes |

## Reading the card

- The two lowest tiers keep the contents at the property or take only selected items through the cleaning plant; neither tier carries storage.
- The four packout tiers take contents into the company's storage facility. Partial and Full Contents Packout are separated by room count: a packout of 3 rooms sits on Partial Contents Packout, and a packout of 4 rooms sits on Full Contents Packout.
- High-Value Contents Packout is a whole-dwelling packout whose inventory itemizes at least 10 high-value items.
- Commercial Contents and Records Recovery is open only to commercial owners, property managers and homeowners associations, for commercial inventory, equipment and records.

## Points of judgement

**Does the tier change during the job?** The tier is the one fixed at booking from the scope in its entry gate.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A booking for the contents of two bedrooms and a den (three rooms) meets the Partial Contents Packout gate of at most 3 rooms; a booking for an entire five-room house meets the Full Contents Packout gate of at least 4 rooms.
